prompt: A market scene with vendors and customers. A fruit vendor is standing behind a stall, holding an apple and talking to a customer. The customer is pointing at a basket of oranges. Next to the oranges is another basket containing four apples. The number of oranges is two more than the number of apples. A vegetable vendor is arranging long carrots on a table next to the fruit stall. The carrots are longer than the round radishes displayed beside them. A child is tugging on her mother's sleeve while pointing at a candy stand. The mother is carrying a shopping bag and looking at the child. A street musician is playing a guitar while sitting on a stool near the market entrance. The fruit vendor is taller than the musician. A dog is sleeping under the musician's stool. An open guitar case is on the ground in front of the musician. The case contains two bills, and the number of coins scattered inside is three times the number of bills.
